newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Jinro Ltd fails to repay loans.
newsitem.headline: Jinro Ltd fails to repay loans.

text.p: Jinro Ltd, South Korea's largest distiller, defaulted on repayments of promissory notes worth about eight billion won on Monday, Jinro's main creditor Commercial Bank of Korea, said on Tuesday.
An official at the bank said final default, which would trigger formal court-receivership proceedings, would be avoided if Jinro meets a final deadline on Tuesday.
In April, Jinro Group became the first conglomerate to benefit from a bank committee's programme to keep troubled corporates afloat.
The committee protected Jinro for two months, and on July 25 agreed to extend 36.9 billion won to Jinro on the condition that the company turn over its managerial rights to creditors.
But Jinro has not complied with that condition and the new loans have not been provided.
"Our bank is not going to provide emergency loans to Jinro unless the company's management gives up its managerial rights," the Commercial bank official said.
